The hierarchy of the Magaambya is as old as the
school itself. Newcomers begin as initiates. Initiates
engage in a period of public service called a Perquisite

wooden mask (typically in the form of an animal,

demonstrating sufficient mastery of Magaambyan
techniques, a conversant becomes a lore-speaker.

Magaambya, shepherding the knowledge of still
more students. In this way, every generation of
students at the Magaambya builds upon the strength
of thousands of teachers and students who have come
before them.
